title: The Session tab: environment, context, connectors, outputs
request: Owner's earlier screenshot of Claude Code's right panel (Environment, Context, Connectors, Changes, Outputs); owner: continue non-stop.
spec: dclab-code server/session_info.js (new), server/app.js (GET sessions/{id}/info), web/app.js (renderSessionInfo), web/index.html, web/style.css
plan: one read-only route from meta and records
a Session tab with four sections

decisions.decision: one Session tab for the four missing sections; Changes stays its own tab
decisions.why: Changes already existed; the rest is small and reads best together

decisions.decision: outputs from the records' Write/Edit tool calls, not from git
decisions.why: git shows the folder's changes (the Changes tab); outputs are what this session's agent wrote, a fork's copied work excluded
'nothing uncommitted' would be a claim about a folder git does not track

findings.defect: every value in the Session tab was set in the code font
findings.cause: the drawer body sets the mono font for all its children
findings.fix: the cards use the sans font; paths and branches keep mono

findings.defect: a folder outside git would read 'Uncommitted: nothing'
findings.scenario: a project that is not a repository
findings.test: server test: not a git folder gives null

outcome: Where a session works, how full its context is, which tool servers it reached and what it wrote are one click away.
lessons: A count that fails to zero must not be shown as a fact.
